title: Add RBAC origin rewriter, KMS region token bridge, and audit rate-fence
author: Marisol Vega
description:
Motivation: Operator sessions that traverse proxy layers were losing origin context which caused KMS region decisions to pick incorrect key scopes and produced duplicate audit noise during retries. This led to two operational pain points: 1) keys being allocated in a different region than the claimed tenant residency, and 2) audit pipelines being flooded by near-duplicate events from session replays.

This PR implements three coordinated components to address the problem while preserving backward compatibility and enabling a staged rollout: 1) RBAC Origin Rewriter: a middleware that normalizes operator session identity by injecting an immutable origin annotation (origin=<region|edge-id>) derived from a verified forwarding header and operator attestation. This makes RBAC decisions region-aware without requiring callers to change their principals. 2) KMS Region Token Bridge: a short-lived signed token issued by the control-plane that binds a request to a KMS region claim; the serving runtime accepts the token and enforces CMK selection by token region affinity. Tokens are TTL-bound and auditable. 3) Audit Rate-Fence: event fingerprinting + leaky-bucket rate-fence placed at the audit-forwarder to coalesce repeated session-replay events into a single representative record with an aggregated count and delta metrics.

What changed (high level): added middleware and runtime handlers, proto for region-token, an audit coalescer service, docs and migration guide, integration tests and e2e canary job. Backwards compatibility: older clients without tokens continue to work; RBAC Origin Rewriter falls back to existing principal path when no verified origin header exists.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4921) - [x] Unit tests for origin rewriter and token bridge - [x] Integration tests for cross-region key selection - [x] Audit forwarder coalescing validation - [x] Helm flag to opt-in rollout - [x] Staged canary deployment run on staging cluster

Rollout plan: stage=off by default; enable via helm flag in a single region, monitor KMS selection and audit ingestion metrics, expand to regions with canary percentage, then enable cluster-wide. If KMS token mismatch occurs runtime falls back to model-variant with no secret use and emits a high-severity audit alert (safe-fail behavior).

Notes on security: tokens are HMAC-signed with rotating signing keys managed by the control plane KMS; token parsing is constant-time to avoid timing leaks. Audit coalescer preserves original raw events in a short-term hotstore (72h) for forensic replay.

Related work: ENG-4921 design, PRs TBD that wire operator attestation into edge proxies.

release_notes: Introduce RBAC origin normalization and short-lived KMS region tokens to improve correct CMK selection and reduce duplicate audit noise. Add an audit rate-fence to coalesce session-replay events. Feature is opt-in behind helm flags; default off. See docs/security for migration steps.
migration_steps: 1) Enable helm flag on a single canary region. 2) Monitor audit.ingest.duplicate_rate and kms.selection_mismatch metrics. 3) If stable, expand canary percentage. 4) Use migration doc to backfill origin annotations for long-lived sessions.
security_considerations: Tokens are HMAC signed with rotating keys stored in control-plane KMS. Token TTL is 30s by default. Origin annotation is marked immutable by the middleware; proxies must provide signed attestation to override. Audit coalescer keeps raw events for 72h and writes aggregated records to long-term store. Any token verification failure is logged as high-severity audit event.
qa_notes: Unit and integration tests added. Manual QA steps: simulate cross-region operator session, verify chosen CMK region in runtime logs, generate rapid retries to validate audit coalescer collapses repeated events. See integration/tests/README.md for scripts.
observability_changes: Added metrics: rbac.origin_inferred_total, kms.region_token_skew_rejections_total, audit.coalesce_collapsed_count, audit.raw_event_retention_seconds. Dashboards added under Observability > Security > Region Tokens.
changelog_entry: 2025-02-03: Added RBAC origin rewriter, KMS region token bridge and audit rate-fence. Opt-in feature behind helm flag. See release notes for rollout instructions.
notes_for_ops: If you see kms.selection_mismatch > 0 after enabling, set the helm flag 'security.allow_token_fallback' to true to soft-fail while investigating. Disable coalescer if audit counts appear underreported (flag: audit.coalescer.enabled=false).
